high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "artbysehgal," which was posted 60 minutes ago. The post features a detailed painting of a woman dressed in traditional attire, adorned with intricate jewelry and a vibrant green shawl draped over her shoulders. She is seated on a chair, holding a red purse with gold embellishments. Two peacocks are perched on either side of her, adding to the richness of the scene. The painting is highly detailed, showcasing rich colors and textures, particularly in the fabric of her dress and the ornate jewelry she wears.
